properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.enabled
properties.description: Enable the outbox relay auto-configuration and schedulers.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of pending events claimed per poll.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.lock-timeout
properties.description: Age after which PROCESSING locks are considered abandoned.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.default-max-attempts
properties.description: Default max publication attempts for new events.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Enable cleanup of published outbox events.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.cleanup.retention
properties.description: Retention period for published events before deletion.
